visual.issue: ph2, ph3 and ph4 are labeled crops but show the whole page shrunk into about 55% of the frame, with large empty bands above and below. The alt text describes partial views ('day boxes for Monday to Thursday', 'the start of the schedule') that do not match what is in frame (r013, r005).
Two whole pages side by side at about 45% width each. Top bar labels, table headers, the fix list and the Contents 'How the links work' text are tiny and hard to read at Etsy zoom (r013).
ph10 is meant to show the Contents page so the buyer sees every section before buying. It shows a day page crop instead, and the 'J' of 'January 11' pokes out past the left edge of the card.
The top bar Money button always opens January 2027 (mm01), even from head-start and mid-year pages. A buyer in July or in Nov 2026 lands on the wrong month and has to use the chip row.

On head-start pages the right tabs swap Nov and Dec 2027 for 'Nov 2026' and 'Dec 2026'. Nov and Dec 2027 cannot be reached from the tabs there, and the 'Dec 2026' label runs right to the bottom edge of the page.
Dec 28 to 31, 2026 sit in Week 1 under January 2027, with no day pages. r008 says this week belongs to December 2026 because its Thursday is Dec 31. The listing does disclose it.
On 5-week months the last week chip ('Week 5', 'Week 31') wraps alone onto a second line under the chip row.
The 'J' descender in January and July headings hangs about 8 px left of the page margin, out of line with everything else on the page.
The short sand bar sits flush against the top edge of the page, so it looks like a clipped element rather than a ruled accent.
Head-start months have no habit tracker, while Contents presents Habit trackers as monthly. An Oct to Dec buyer's first months have none.
